description: How Claude Harness improves itself. The loop is deterministic: no model, no secret. It proposes; a person merges.
level_meaning: L0 evals exist; L1 evals gate merges in CI; L2 a scheduled loop runs and writes proposals; L3 the loop improves itself. Claude Harness is at L2: .github/workflows/improve.yml runs scripts/improve.mjs daily and writes a proposal, and .github/workflows/test.yml reruns the tests and evals weekly. It is not L3: the loop does not change its own steps.

loop.note: review runs the golden tasks; extract compares them with eval/baseline.json; propose lists failing tasks and outdated or deprecated dependencies and tries the in-range updates on the CI runner; validate is CI on the pull request; ship is a person merging it.

eval.rubric: eval/run-eval.mjs over eval/golden-tasks.json (23 golden tasks: L1 payload invariants, L2 live scaffolds, L3 the CLI with flags, the MCP server, the plugin hook, the installed blockers, the plugin manifests, memory search) and test/install.test.js (19 tests), run by pnpm test and pnpm run eval
eval.gate: all tests and golden tasks pass && evals_passed >= eval/baseline.json

externalIntelligence.source: none yet; the loop reads only this repository and the package registry
